title: Preserve schema meaning across Arrow, Delta and schema evolution
brief: Distinguish representation conversion, value casting, schema normalization and table evolution. A successful Arrow conversion does not by itself authorize a Delta write or preserve every Arrow datatype exactly.

choices.choose_when: Appending values without changing table metadata
choices.tradeoff: Check actual nullability, nested fields and protocol-dependent types

choices.choose_when: Additive source fields should evolve the table
choices.tradeoff: Existing rows need compatible missing-field/null behavior; mapped tables have extra restrictions

choices.choose_when: A full replacement also changes schema
choices.tradeoff: Requires overwrite mode and operation-specific validation

choices.choose_when: You need a schema at the integration boundary
choices.tradeoff: Conversion errors and normalization are separate from row-value casting

claims.statement: WriteBuilder::with_cast_safety(true) converted invalid string-to-integer values to null in the probe; false returned an error. Merge/update spell this policy with_safe_cast.
A wider batch failed without schema mode, then SchemaMode::Merge added its field and supplied null for an old row.

Check nested child nullability, decimal precision/scale, signedness, timestamp units/timezone and mapping metadata explicitly. Normalized schema identity is not byte-identical Arrow schema preservation.

The nested decimal field retained precision/scale and nullability through normalized kernel/Arrow conversion. In the tested profile a nanosecond UTC schema normalized to microseconds, and UInt64 schema conversion round-tripped as Int64; successful conversion is not signedness or timestamp-unit preservation.

implementation: Inspect both schema and values after conversion; do not infer losslessness from trait names.
Choose cast failure behavior according to whether null substitution is acceptable to the application.
Keep the nanosecond Cargo feature and table protocol feature separate; compare the consumer profile with the documentation capture.
errors: Unsupported Arrow types, incompatible field changes, invalid values and missing protocol features fail at different boundaries.
unknowns: The local controls cover additive nullable fields, string/integer casts, a nested decimal schema, unsigned schema conversion and timestamp normalization. Every value-range, timezone and nested evolution combination is not certified.

evidence.scope: Exact git-capture full contracts for the selected operations
Pinned delta-rs implementation; full file retained with acquisition provenance
Named local assertions only; see profile, fixtures and source digests

coverage: reviewed decision brief; runtime scope is limited to named tests
